description.narrative: On 13th March 2019, EBRD approved investments in a series of EUR-denominated mortgage covered bonds to be issued by Tatra banka, a.s. ("Tatra") under the EBRD Covered Bond Framework II for Slovakia. On 24th June 2019, EBRD subscribed EUR 25 million to the EUR 250 million covered bond issued by Tatra with 7-year tenor. 60% of the proceeds were to be directed to green sub-projects in line with EBRD Green Economy Transition ("GET") criteria. On 25th January 2023, EBRD subscribed EUR 40 million to the EUR 500 million covered bond issued by Tatra with 3-year tenor. 100% of the proceeds are to be directed to green sub-projects in line with EBRD GET criteria. On 2nd Octoher 2024, EBRD subscribed EUR 19 million to the EUR 500 million covered bond issued by Tatra with 4-year tenor. 100% of the proceeds are to be directed to green sub-projects in line with EBRD GET criteria. All bonds are listed on Bratislava Stock Exchange. The project seeks to support a systematically important bank to strengthen its resilience, diversify funding sources and enhance asset-liability profile. The project also contributes to capital market development by enabling continued issuances of covered bonds in Slovakia. The project strongly supports the green agenda in Slovakia with Tatra committing since 2019 to allocate 60%, and since 2022 100% of EBRD's participation to financing green projects in line with EBRD's GET requirements.
